tasks.short: Draw scaled master sketches relating installations to facilities.

steps.what: Find and verify actual facility drawings, installation specifications and dimensions
Draw master sketches to scale in the engineering drawing system {OTHER}
Verify final installation relationships, exact dimensions, specifications and sketch scale
Save the checked final master-sketch revision

tasks.design: Configure project-reference search and native external drawing references in the engineering drawing system {OTHER}. Reuse actual facility geometry, installation symbols and dimensions; the drafter still decides the depicted relationships and checks the complete final scaled sketch before saving it in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Master sketches can repeat source finding and drawing of unchanged facility geometry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native references and reusable drawing components can reduce repeated source and geometry entry.
tasks.still_hard: Correct relationships, applicability of dimensions and drawing clarity need drafting judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter notices when a scaled drawing gives a misleading account of the real installation.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated geometry entry; drafting and design authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: engineering drawing tools can reuse external geometry and symbols; actual electrical installation relationships and dimensions still need verification.

assumptions: Boundary is scaled sketch creation through its saved checked revision; design approval and construction belong to actual authorised owners with no saved labour claimed.

Facility drawing owner supplies actual drawing identifier, revision, coordinate basis and dimensions; designer supplies actual installation specifications. Drafter checks source applicability in s1 and manually enters missing or incompatible geometry in s2. No free survey or drawing conversion is assumed.

Test native source search and references before code. Existing referenced geometry earns no saving. Only repeated source finding and geometry entry change; relation choices and actual specification checking remain in retained work.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Final save is one percent fully retained and uses the existing sketch check.
unknowns: How much facility geometry is already referenced?
Which specifications arrive in compatible formats?
research_questions: Can actual sketch revisions reuse geometry without losing source revision or dimension applicability?

incremental.description: Maintain project-reference filters and reusable drawing components.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final scaled master sketch, exact revision and document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.25 source finding + 50*0.40 repeated geometry = 25; subtract 1 upkeep = 24. With half that source and geometry entry eligible, 12.5 minus 1 = 11.5. Drawing judgement and final save stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Resolve design problems with vendors and design staff.

steps.what: Review actual work orders and procedural manuals for the design problem
Confer with vendors or design staff to resolve problems or agree design modifications
outputs: actual agreed design resolution and authority

steps.what: Modify the actual drawing in the engineering drawing system {OTHER}
inputs: actual agreed design resolution and authority

steps.what: Check the final modified design and record actual resolution references
inputs: actual agreed design resolution and authority
outputs: checked final modified design and resolution record

steps.what: Save the checked modified design and resolution record
inputs: checked final modified design and resolution record

tasks.design: Configure work-order/manual retrieval in {DOCS} and native linked symbols in the engineering drawing system {OTHER}. The drafter still reviews the problem, confers with actual vendors or design staff and checks the final drawing against their actual agreed resolution before saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Problem resolution can repeat manual finding and related drawing updates.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search and linked drawing components can reduce retrieval and repeated geometry edits.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving conflicting specifications and understanding vendor limitations require real discussion and design authority.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter spots a proposed fix that does not resolve the actual installation problem.
tasks.altitude: Less retrieval and repeated drawing entry; design-change authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: document filters and linked drawing symbols can reduce retrieval and repeated edits; actual design resolution and vendor agreement remain human.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual problem review, discussion, drawing modification and existing resolution record. Reweight discussion-only cases rather than inventing a drawing change. Actual engineer approval remains a real source dependency, not saved focal labour.

Work-order owner supplies actual issue and drawing identifiers; manual owner supplies actual applicability and revision. Actual vendor or design-staff resolution and authority arise in s2. Drafter captures them in s3-s4; missing sources, unapproved changes and unsupported drawing links remain manual.
Test native retrieval and linked components before code. Existing links earn no saving. Only source finding and repeated linked geometry change, not source reading, discussion or decisions.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Same-system save has one percent fully retained time and uses the existing drawing check.
unknowns: Which manual and drawing references are already linked?
research_questions: Can linked components reduce actual edits without propagating an unapproved design change?

incremental.description: Maintain manual filters and linked drawing components.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final modified design and actual resolution record, exact revision and document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.30 retrieval + 25*0.20 repeated geometry = 9.5; minus 0.8 upkeep = 8.7. If half the retrieval and edits are eligible, 4.75 minus 0.8 = 3.95. Actual discussions, judgement and save time remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Locate project files, load programs and record completed jobs.

steps.what: Locate and check specified project files and program revision in the database library {OTHER}
outputs: checked selected project files and program revision

steps.what: Load the checked project program into the engineering workstation system {OTHER}
inputs: checked selected project files and program revision

steps.what: Enter and check actual completed job data and project references
inputs: actual job timing and output references

steps.what: Commit the checked actual completed-job data record

tasks.design: Configure native project-library filters and a checked project-open profile in the engineering workstation system {OTHER}. Reuse actual project and output references in {PROJECT}; the drafter checks the program before loading and enters and checks completion data only after actual job evidence exists.
tasks.previous_blocker: Project finding, workstation path selection and completion records can repeat identifiers and file references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native library filters, project profiles and linked job fields can reduce navigation and repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: The drafter must select the right revision and distinguish a loaded program from actual completed work.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter catches a wrong project revision or unsupported completion claim.
tasks.altitude: Less library navigation and job metadata entry; completion responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: engineering libraries and project profiles can reuse checked paths and job references; actual completion must still be verified and recorded.

assumptions: Boundary is library finding, program loading and actual job-data recording; drawing execution itself is another actual task, not labour removed here. Program loading never counts as job completion.

Library owner supplies actual project identifier, file path, revision and approved program profile. Drafter verifies these in s1. Actual job execution supplies output revision and timing evidence; drafter verifies and manually captures missing completion fields in s3 after actual completion. Existing source capture is not assumed free: unsupported timing or output references remain manual in s3 retained time.

Test native filters, project-open profiles and linked job fields before code. Existing file-load runtime is system time and earns no labour saving; the s2 cut concerns repeated path navigation only. Already-populated completion data earns no new saving.

Shares and reductions are provisional, not measured baselines. Final commit is one percent fully retained. Existing program selection and job-record checks supply exact-version gates without added approval stages.
unknowns: How much path navigation and job entry is repeated?
Which completion and timing fields already exist?
research_questions: Do native project profiles reduce navigation while still checking the exact program revision?

incremental.description: Maintain project-open profiles and completion-field mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s1 checked selected project files and exact program revision, profile and workstation destination; changes require recheck
s3 checked final actual completed-job data record and exact project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 30*0.50 finding + 20*0.20 navigation + 49*0.40 repeated job fields = 38.6; minus 1 upkeep = 37.6. If half that navigation and repeated entry qualifies, 19.3 minus 1 = 18.3. Program runtime and routine final commit supply no labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop and verify drafting specifications from electronic schematics.

steps.what: Find actual electronic schematics and supporting specification documents
inputs: actual schematic and supporting document revisions

steps.what: Examine electronic schematics and develop actual configuration, dimension and tolerance inputs
outputs: verified drafting calculation inputs and chosen methods

steps.what: Compute drafting dimensions and tolerances using actual selected formulas
inputs: verified drafting calculation inputs and chosen methods

steps.what: Verify actual computed specifications against schematics, configuration and design intent
Write and check the actual drafting specification record and references
Save the checked final drafting specification record

tasks.design: Configure schematic-reference search and native checked calculation fields in the engineering system {OTHER} or {SPREADSHEET}. The drafter interprets the schematic, supplies and checks actual inputs and selected formulas, then verifies computed specifications and records the final findings.
tasks.previous_blocker: Specification work can repeat source finding and dimension or tolerance arithmetic.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document filters and reusable checked calculation configurations can reduce retrieval and repeated arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: Design intent, applicable tolerances and schematic ambiguity need drafting and engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The drafter notices a mathematically correct specification that contradicts the actual assembly or circuit.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive arithmetic; specification and design authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: engineering calculation fields can repeat selected dimension and tolerance formulas; schematic interpretation and specification validity remain human judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is developing, computing and verifying actual drafting specifications through their existing record, without granting new design approval authority.

Design-source owners provide actual schematic identifier, revision and component specification. Drafter reads and captures actual dimensions, units, tolerances and chosen formula in s2. Missing fields and ambiguous schematics stay manual before s3; no automatic semantic schematic interpretation is assumed.

Test native filters and calculation configuration before code. Existing automatic formulas and solver runtime earn no labour saving. Only actual repeated source finding and arithmetic change; all source interpretation and verification remain human.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Final save is one percent fully retained and uses the existing specification-record check.
unknowns: What specifications need actual engineering clarification?
research_questions: Can configured formulas reproduce actual specification examples and unit/tolerance edge cases?

incremental.description: Maintain source filters and checked dimension/tolerance formulas.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final actual drafting specification record and exact document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.25 finding + 20 arithmetic = 25; subtract 1 upkeep = 24. If half the sources and calculations are still manual and eligible, 12.5 minus 1 = 11.5. Interpretation, verification and save time remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The drafter keeps schematic interpretation and revision responsibility while reducing repeated geometry, navigation and calculations.
role.ambitious_version: Design decision rights stay unchanged; validate reduced repeated entry on actual electrical drafting projects.
